entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number 81-Charlie-450.

Right to it. Let me pull up that order, 81-Charlie-450. Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. That was 37 days ago. To get this started, what specifically is the issue with the band?
Look, I don't have time for a long story. I tried to return this on day 9, but your whole system was down. I need the return label that I should have gotten weeks ago.

I understand. Let me check our records for that date... yes, I'm seeing a major note in our system. We had a `website error` on December 24th that caused a significant outage. A lot of customers reported they `couldn't print` labels because the return `system` was `down` for several hours. My apologies for that.
I even took a `screenshot` of the error page. So, are you going to process this or not?

That won't be necessary, the system note is all the proof I need. Of course. Since you attempted the return during the valid period and were blocked by our error, I will absolutely process this for you. Looking at our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window anyway, so it's no problem at all. I've approved the return.
Finally. So the label is on its way?

Yes. It's been sent to the email on file. And for the trouble our system caused you, and as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added a $50 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchase.
Okay. I have the email now. The credit is fine. That's all.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
